atomic_cutover: One code-only change. api/groups moves file for file to modules/schoolstructure/http (package schoolstructurehttp, school-structure/http) and api/admin to workflows/gradetransition/http (package gradetransitionhttp, grade-transition/http); the owners inbound-groups and inbound-admin are deleted with their package entries and their two rules move to the new points, which carry their own rules for the shared HTTP runtime (api/common), the token adapter, the permission registry, the tenant runtime, the Security Runtime and, for the group routes, their own group service and rows and the People Directory's public types; the root mounts both. The routes use common.ProtectedTenantRoutes instead of the unused *bun.DB and tenant.WithinCurrentTenant instead of tenant.WithTenantTx; the group routes read the children and persons of a group through the GroupPeople port that services.NewGroupRoutePeople binds over the retained person service, and the admin wildcard through securityruntime.HasAdminWildcard. services/education drops database/sql, internal/timezone, models/audit, models/base, models/facilities, models/users, realtime, tenant and bun: its writes run on its Runtime port (schoolStructureCompose.LegacyRepositoryRuntime), the group, teacher-link, class-assignment and handover stores, the room, teacher, staff and caregiver directories and both audit trails are its own ports over the models/education vocabulary (Teacher, Caregiver, HandoverQuery, SubstitutionChange, SchoolClassChange, ErrHandoverExists), bound by database/repositories (EducationRooms, EducationStaff, EducationCaregivers, EducationHandovers, EducationSubstitutionAudit, EducationClassAssignmentAudit) and services (EducationTeachers); the broadcaster is the Delivery realtimeevents.Publisher. models/education carries its id, timestamp and tenant columns itself (Model, TenantModel with the same tags), keeps the room as its GroupRoom projection and a substitution's staff as SubstitutionStaff, classifies a missing row through its own RepositoryNotFound-marked ErrNotFound and DatabaseError, and its repository contracts move to database/repositories (education_repositories.go) and the consumer ports of services/users and the notification resolver; the unused setters SetRoom, SetTeacher, SetRegularStaff and SetSubstituteStaff and the Timetable owner's ClassArrivalTime model are deleted. database/repositories/education runs on a consumer-owned Runtime, replaces the generic base repository with explicit statements on education.groups (CountGroups replaces CountWithOptions, the generic ListWithOptions is gone) and deletes ClassArrivalTimeRepository, whose rows the Timetable owner serves; the fixtures write and read class arrival times directly. The suites compose through api/testutil (services/school_structure_suite_test_helpers.go) and name rows through test. The stale rules calendar-view.adapter-test.facilities-domain and care-plan.contracttest.school-structure.domain are deleted. No fallback provider, no second route surface, no capability behavior added.
